samples.summary: New single write path `applyStyleToSelection` marks dirty with a context-relative index against the body block array — wrong block (or a crash) when editing a header/footer
samples.evidence: packages/docs/src/view/text-editor.ts:2935-2952 — `startIdx/endIdx` come from `this.doc.getBlockIndex()`, which resolves against `Doc.getContextBlocks()` (document.ts:211-212, header/footer aware), but line 2951 dereferences `this.doc.document.blocks[i].id` (body only). While editing a header/footer, a cross-block style write marks an unrelated body block dirty and, when the header has more blocks than the body (e.g. header index 2, body length 1), `this.doc.document.blocks[i]` is `undefined` and `.id` throws. The diff consolidates the B/I/U/S toggles, clear formatting (Cmd+\) and the format painter apply into this one function and documents it as "a body range marks the span", so all three keyboard commands now share the mismatch. The code itself is relocated from the old `toggleStyle`/`clearFormatting`, so the defect predates the diff, but the diff makes it the single write path for every keyboard style command.

samples.summary: `applyStyleImpl`'s dirty-marking still uses the body-only `layout.blockParentMap` and `doc.document.blocks[i]`, while the reads it now agrees with moved to the merged `doc.blockParentMap`
samples.evidence: packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:1032-1048 (and the identical copy at 2965-2982 in `insertLink`): the reads in this diff were deliberately switched to `doc.blockParentMap` (the header+footer+body merged map built at editor.ts:1291-1298) because `layout.blockParentMap` cannot resolve a header/footer table cell. The write's dirty-marking here was not: it still asks `layout.blockParentMap`, so for a caret/range inside a *header or footer* table cell both lookups miss, execution falls to `doc.getBlockIndex()` (header-context indices) and then indexes `doc.document.blocks[i]` (body), marking the wrong block dirty or dereferencing `undefined.id`. The style is written correctly by the newly shared traversal but the affected region can render stale.

samples.summary: Text-box `getSelectionStyle()` now returns the *effective* style (named-style defaults layered in); the toolbar color swatches that consume it were not updated
samples.evidence: packages/docs/src/view/text-box-editor.ts:980-987 changes `getSelectionStyle()` from raw `inline.style` to `caretStyle(true)` (named-style inline defaults merged under the run). Un-updated consumers of that value: packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/text-format-group.tsx:239 (`color={selectionStyle?.color || defaultTextColor}`) and :269 (`currentColor={selectionStyle?.backgroundColor}`), reached for slides/board text boxes via packages/frontend/src/app/slides/toolbar/text-edit-section.tsx:83-87 and packages/slides/src/view/editor/text-box-editor.ts:598-599. A heading-6 block, whose built-in named style supplies `color: '#666666'`, now renders the swatch as if the user had explicitly chosen grey rather than "no explicit color", and the same for `fontSize`/`fontFamily` reads elsewhere off the caret style.

samples.summary: Header/footer slim toolbar B/I/U toggles got the new summary-based decision but still render no `pressed` state, so the button never reflects the value it toggles from
samples.evidence: packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:449, :458 and the underline toggle below render `<Toggle size="sm" onPressedChange={toggleBold} …>` with no `pressed` prop, while the handlers at :391-406 now derive add-vs-remove from `getRangeStyleSummary()`. The shared `TextFormatGroup` was updated to `pressed={isStyleOn(styleSummary?.bold)}` (text-format-group.tsx:163) in the same change, so the two docs surfaces now disagree about what the button shows.

samples.summary: `stepSelectionFontSize` now feeds cell-block ids to `DocStore.applyStyles` for the first time (cross-block selection containing a table)
samples.evidence: packages/docs/src/view/editor.ts:1089-1117 — the run collection is now `visitStyledRunsInRange`, which for a body range spanning a table emits every cell block whole (range-slices.ts top-level branch), whereas the previous hand-rolled walk emitted nothing for a table block (its `inlines` are empty). Those cell block ids now reach `docStore.applyStyles` (packages/frontend/src/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.ts:1733-1775). `resolveBlockTreePath` (yorkie-doc-store.ts:788-824) does search inside table blocks, so this most likely works; flagging it as an input shape that store implementation had not previously received on this path — any `DocStore` whose `applyStyles` resolves only top-level/region blocks would now throw `Block not found` on a font-size step across a table.

verdict.reason: Code is exactly as described. text-editor.ts:2935-2936 derives indices from Doc.getBlockIndex, which is context-relative (document.ts:211-212 -> getContextBlocks, document.ts:98-102 returns header/footer blocks when editContext is not 'body'), yet text-editor.ts:2951 indexes the body array `this.doc.document.blocks[i]`. The path is reachable: the keyboard switch calls toggleStyle at text-editor.ts:874/880/886/892/898/904 and clearFormatting at 928 with no editContext guard (contrast the explicit header/footer guard for page breaks at text-editor.ts:800 and the Escape handler at 765), header/footer editing is entered at text-editor.ts:1429/1455, and multi-block header/footer selections are an explicitly supported state (deleteSelection's dedicated header/footer multi-block branch at text-editor.ts:3151-3159 walking getContextBlocks). With a header holding more blocks than the body, `this.doc.document.blocks[i]` is undefined and `.id` throws; otherwise an unrelated body block is marked dirty while the edited header block is not. I found no guard, invariant, or caller-side check that prevents this, so no refutation ground applies (the identical body-only deref at editor.ts:1046 corroborates rather than refutes).

verdict.reason: The cited code exists verbatim. editor.ts:1032-1048 (applyStyleImpl) and the mirrored copy at editor.ts:2965-2982 (insertLink) resolve endpoints through `layout.blockParentMap`, which is built only from `doc.document.blocks` (editor.ts:1244-1253) — header/footer parentage lives in headerLayout/footerLayout and is only merged into `doc.blockParentMap` (editor.ts:1291-1298), which is what the reads now use (model/range-slices.ts:117-120). The fallback then calls `doc.getBlockIndex()`, which is edit-context aware (model/document.ts:211-213 -> getContextBlocks, document.ts:98-102), and applies the resulting header/footer index to the body array `doc.document.blocks[i]` (editor.ts:1046, 2979). In header/footer edit context this marks an unrelated body block dirty, and throws on `undefined.id` when the header/footer region has more top-level blocks than the body. The path is reachable: editContext is mirrored onto the Doc (view/text-editor.ts:248-251), header/footer editing is fully wired (editor.ts:1682-1727, 3660-3662), and applyStyle/insertLink are public toolbar entry points (editor.ts:2748, 2937) with no body-context guard. One sub-case in the reviewer's narrative is imprecise (a caret inside a header *table cell* yields getBlockIndex === -1, so the branch is skipped silently rather than crashing), but the core defect — body-only dirty map plus context-aware indices against the body array — is real and unguarded, so no refutation ground applies.
